verdict.rationale: vLLM ships an OpenAI-compatible API server (and Docker image) that runs as a standalone service (vllm-docs-9, vllm-docs-26, vllm-docs-27), which by nature is network-accessible and commonly bound to a host/port for LAN access. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents host/port binding flags, firewall/network configuration, or any hands-on report of accessing the server from another device on a LAN. missing for 10: explicit --host/--port or network-binding documentation, and independent confirmation of successful LAN access from another device.
